title: Worse than Zero-shot? A Fact-Checking Dataset for Evaluating the Robustness of RAG Against Misleading Retrievals
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in the context of political fact-checking and misleading information retrieval; it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, or ethical/moral frameworks.
